headline: Tankers Struck Near Strait of Hormuz as Saudi Arabia Intercepts Houthi Missiles
summary: Two commercial tankers were struck by unidentified projectiles near Khasab in the Strait of Hormuz. Separately, coalition forces intercepted five Houthi ballistic and cruise missiles over Saudi Arabia.
why: The Strait of Hormuz is the world's most critical maritime oil transit choke point, handling roughly a fifth of global petroleum supply.

impacts.name: Brent Crude
impacts.why: Physical maritime attacks in the Strait of Hormuz escalate risks to global oil shipping routes.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Attacks on commercial vessels near the Strait of Hormuz heightened supply disruption concerns in energy markets.
